verdict.rationale: Qapita is a cap table and equity management platform, so a programmatic cap-table API is a fair question for it. The evidence only describes UI-level cap table, ESOP and vesting management and never mentions a developer API. Probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404, so no documented API for pulling stakeholders, share classes, securities or vesting states is evidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull the full capitalization table — stakeholders, share classes, securities, and vesting states — through a documented programmatic API
